categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
